notes: The claim-check ledger enumerated and classified. Week 1 deliverable 1. Classification is a judgement by a single rater against criteria fixed in the ledger file before any entry was classified.
name: claim_check_inventory
reconciliation_note: Enumerating every entry the repository describes gives 23 against the 21 asserted in docs/HANDOFF.md §3, a difference of +2. It is recorded, not resolved, because resolving it means editing §3, which belongs to the write-up. The two candidate sources, both visible in the text: (a) §3's prose says "the five found on 2026-09-05" and then lists FOUR bullets, so one member of that five is already a row in the §3 table and may be counted twice here as L08 or L09; (b) L23 carries no ordinal and §6n calls it "a sibling worth reporting beside" L22 rather than numbering it, so whether it is a ledger entry or an annotation on L22 is undecided in the source. Under reading (a)+(b) the count is 21 exactly. That is a plausible reconstruction and it is not what any document says, so it is not adopted.
what_this_licenses: a described and classified inventory of the ledger's own entries
what_this_does_not_license: a field-wide failure rate, a claim that the classification is reproducible between raters, or a count of independent training observations
